الضيافة The Philosophy

Coffee first.
Then everything else.

The guest room is the oldest room in an Emirati home — the one kept ready for whoever comes. Coffee is poured before a name is asked. Dates are set down before a reason is given. Nothing is sold here; everything is offered.

Nothing on this menu is alcoholic, and nothing on it pretends to be. What is poured here is what the Gulf has always poured — gahwa, tea in a narrow glass, something cold and pressed the same morning — and a small sweet set beside it.

Hours
06:30 — 19:00
Sunday to Thursday
Service
All day, at your seat.
Sweet tray from 15:00.

The Ritual

Gahwa is poured with the right hand, a third of a cup at a time, and refilled for as long as the cup is held out. To close the ritual, tilt the cup gently twice. Your host will understand, and will not ask again.

أهلاً وسهلاً

You have arrived among your people

The Tray

From three o'clock, a small tray of the day's sweets comes with every hot drink, unasked. Take one, take none. It is set down either way.
